ideas.pitch: An AI-powered patient symptom ingestion and pre-triage platform tailored for overcrowded rural clinics in India, featuring regional language support and automated urgency scoring.
ideas.title: AuraCare AI Triage Engine
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly addresses the HealthTech Innovation theme with localized impact, solving real emergency waiting room bottlenecks that judges will immediately recognize.

ideas.pitch: A graph-intelligence-based anomaly detection platform to trace counterfeit pharmaceutical drug supply chains and flag illicit distributor networks.
ideas.title: MediGraph AML Risk Detector for Pharma Supply
ideas.why_it_could_win: Brings heavy technical execution to the HealthTech space by applying graph intelligence to supply chain safety rather than just building another basic symptom checker.

ideas.pitch: An AI-driven nutritional and wellness recommendation engine that blends modern dietary metrics with traditional Ayurvedic food principles for personalized meal plans.
ideas.title: AyurNutri Personalizer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the winning formula of tailored wellness platforms while adding localized cultural relevance that resonates strongly with Indian judges.

ideas.pitch: An automated satellite image analysis tool that correlates local industrial land emissions with regional respiratory disease spikes to warn public health officials.
ideas.title: SafeZone Satellite Health-Hazard Mapper
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines spatial monitoring with healthcare outcomes, providing a novel data-driven angle that stands out from typical app-layer health hacks.

ideas.pitch: A multi-agent RAG system designed for elderly patients to navigate health insurance policies, book appointments, and manage daily medication schedules through a voice interface.
ideas.title: ElderLink Multi-Agent Support Network
ideas.why_it_could_win: Utilizes a sophisticated multi-agent architecture to solve an accessible, high-empathy problem in the healthcare domain.
